items.title: 第 1 题 · 采样率越高、量化位数越多，数字声音质量越好
items.style: 科技波形风，深靛蓝底，青绿与粉色发光波形，录音棚质感
items.layout: A＝调音台两个旋钮｜B＝采样点与量化台阶｜C＝三组参数划叉｜D＝结论条
items.prompt: Tech waveform infographic, landscape, four-zone layout, deep indigo background with teal and pink glowing curves, studio mood, subtle grid, clean composition. Zone A (left, about 60% width): a recording-studio mixing console seen at an angle — two large prominent knobs stand in the middle of the panel, both turned clockwise to high positions with glowing rings, and a horizontal quality meter above them has its needle at the far right; small sliders, buttons and a headphone jack fill the rest of the panel; a microphone on a boom arm and a pair of headphones rest on a stand nearby; a coffee cup and a notebook sit at the panel edge. Zone B (upper right): a two-part comparison stacked vertically — the upper half shows one smooth wave with sparse dots marked along it next to a denser wave with many dots; the lower half shows a coarse staircase with few tall steps beside a fine staircase with many short steps; thin dimension lines link the dots to the sampling idea and the steps to the precision idea. Zone C (lower right): a pale card with three rows of small tags, each row struck through with a thin grey line. Zone D (bottom full-width bar): a dark rounded conclusion strip with a teal check badge. Text on the image is Simplified Chinese only, in four short labels: "采样率", "量化位数", "越高", "越清晰" — bold sans-serif on small dark rounded plates, each label no more than four characters. 16:9 landscape, high resolution, clean background.

items.title: 第 7 题 · IPv4 是 32 位、IPv6 是 128 位

items.prompt: Tech spec-card infographic, landscape, four-zone layout, deep blue background, cyan outlines with soft glow, metallic licence-plate texture. Zone C (lower right): a pale card showing two numbers in a vertical column, each beside a small address bar icon, with a clear divider between the two rows. Zone D (bottom full-width bar): a dark rounded conclusion strip with a cyan check badge. Text on the image is Simplified Chinese only, in three short labels: "32 位", "128 位", "门牌号" — bold sans-serif on small dark rounded plates, each label no more than four characters. 16:9 landscape, high resolution, clean background.
